children: Littelfuse announced that Deepak Nayar will transition from Senior Vice President and General Manager, Electronics Business to Special Advisor to the Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2027.
Senior Vice President and General Manager, Electronics Business → Special Advisor to the Chief Executive Officer
Transition Date: December 31, 2026; Special Advisor effective January 1, 2027
Employee advised company of intention to transition

To serve an Advisory Term under a Special Advisor Employment Agreement with total advisory-term payments of $1,004,220; eligible for accelerated vesting for outstanding LTI awards upon retirement; not eligible for new AIP or LTI awards during Advisory Term
